map.用 Mifflin-St Jeor 算 BMR：基础代谢 BMR：男 = 10×: BMR via Mifflin-St Jeor: for men BMR = 10×weight + 6.25×height − 5×age + 5; for women BMR = 10×weight + 6.25×height − 5×age − 161 (weight in kg, height in cm). With a body-fat percentage, switch to Katch-McArdle: 370 + 21.6×lean body mass.
map.乘活动系数得 TDEE：每日总消耗 TDEE = BMR × 活动系数（久坐约: Multiply by the activity factor to get TDEE: total daily expenditure TDEE = BMR × activity factor (sedentary about 1.2, light 1.375, moderate 1.5, high 1.725, very high 1.9).
map.按目标定热量与宏量：减脂：TDEE − 500（约 0.5kg/周）；增肌：TD: Set calories and macros from the goal: fat loss TDEE − 500 (about 0.5 kg/week); muscle gain TDEE + 300; maintenance unchanged. Macro splits for fat loss 35% protein / 40% carbs / 25% fat, for gain 25/50/25, for maintenance 25/45/30.
map.算例：男 30 岁、175cm、70kg、活动系数 1.5: Worked example: male, 30 years, 175 cm, 70 kg, activity factor 1.5
map.偏高会高估消耗，建议先用 1.4-1.5 试算再微调: Too high a value overestimates expenditure; try 1.4–1.5 first and then fine-tune
map.活动系数怎么选才准？: How Do You Pick an Accurate Activity Factor?
map.按实际一周运动量取：办公室久坐选 1.2；每周 1-3 次轻运动 1.375；3: Pick based on actual weekly activity: 1.2 for a desk job, 1.375 for 1–3 light sessions a week, 1.5 for 3–5 moderate sessions, 1.725–1.9 for physical labor or high-intensity training. Too high overestimates expenditure, so try 1.4–1.5 first and then fine-tune.
map.有体脂率用哪种公式更好？: With Body Fat Data, Which Formula Is Better?
map.有体脂率时 Katch-McArdle（基于瘦体重）比 Mifflin 更稳，不: With a body-fat percentage, Katch-McArdle (based on lean body mass) is steadier than Mifflin because it does not shift with the fat share of body weight. Without body-fat data, Mifflin-St Jeor is fine — it is one of the more accurate formulas for modern populations.
